evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2015 (11 years old), 70 m NW: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2017 (fire C10784), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
S facing slope, 13 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 120 m SW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).
